facts: Identity check at reconciliation (v5 D9): gamma-MnO2 = nsutite, a disordered intergrowth of ramsdellite and pyrolusite with no single space group; not the rutile-type MnO2 (that is beta-MnO2, pyrolusite); rutile-type (P4_2/mnm): no. Source: https://www.crystallography.net/cod/1514239.html | https://www.crystallography.net/cod/8103498.html | https://www.crystallography.net/cod/2105790.html | https://www.handbookofmineralogy.org/pdfs/nsutite.pdf
